rationale: The original thesis is intact and arguably strengthening — the +7.4% gap still fully holds on ~36x relative volume, price has migrated from 84% to 94% of range, sits above rising VWAP, and is coiling on shrinking volume directly under the $31.97 high, which reads as absorption rather than distribution while SPY stays weak. The stall is a low-volatility contraction (5m ATR ~3 cents) in the midday dead zone, not thesis failure, and risk remains well-defined: a stop below the $31.71 day-low invalidation caps loss near $150 against a ~2.5:1 reward skew to continuation. Flipping short would fight demonstrated relative strength with no supporting evidence, and closing forfeits bounded optionality on an unchanged setup.
